steps.title: Prepare custom tip arrangement
steps.instruction: Arrange the 300 µL tiprack so that rows B, D, F, and H are empty, leaving tips only on alternating nozzles to enable non‑standard multi‑channel pipetting for the custom racks; this can be done manually or by running the separate “Custom Tip Arranging” protocol (part‑2).

steps.title: Load p300 multi‑channel pipette
steps.instruction: Mount the 300 µL tips on the p300 multi‑channel pipette in the custom arrangement prepared in the previous step.

steps.title: Top‑dispense 250 µL into caps
steps.instruction: Aspirate 250 µL of liquid from the reservoir and top‑dispense 250 µL into each cap (up to 96 caps) arranged in columns of 4 across up to four custom racks (each rack has 6 columns of 4 caps). After filling all caps in a rack, either drop the tips or optionally change tips after every dispense; tip tracking is optional.

substeps.instruction: Top‑dispense 250 µL per cap to each column of caps in the custom racks.
Optionally drop tips after completing a rack or change tips after each dispense; tip tracking may be used to record the starting tip position.
